1e4fa37db6ac9a35.description: About the Role CEER is seeking a Parts Advisor to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves greeting and assisting customers, processing parts orders, and coordinating with service teams to fulfill parts requirements. The Parts Advisor will also manage customer inquiries, handle returns, and maintain accurate records. Key Responsibilities Greet and assist walk-in parts retail customers at the parts counter, identifying correct parts and accessories based on customer and vehicle requirements. Process parts retail and service sales orders accurately in SAP, ensuring correct pricing, discounts, and invoicing in line with CEER commercial policy. Promote accessories and value-added parts/service offers to maximize basket size and support achievement of retail sales targets. Coordinate with Service Advisors and Technicians to fulfill parts requirements for scheduled and walk-in service jobs. Pick, verify, and issue parts against repair orders and work orders in a timely manner to minimize vehicle turnaround time. Follow up on back-ordered or unavailable parts and communicate expected availability to service teams and customers. Respond to customer inquiries on part availability, pricing, and compatibility. Handle first-line customer complaints related to parts sales and escalate complex issues to the Parts Operations Assistant Manager. Process returns, exchanges, and warranty claims according to established SOPs. Maintain accurate records of retail and service sales transactions and daily cash/counter stock reconciliation. Generate routine daily/weekly sales activity reports for the Parts Operations Assistant Manager. Support month-end stock and sales reconciliation activities. Follow CEER Aftersales SOPs & Policies requirements for all transactions and maintain a clean, organized, and safe parts retail/counter area. Qualifications and Experience High school diploma or equivalent in a related field. A minimum of 2 years of experience in a relevant field. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, offering an opportunity to contribute to CEER's aftersales operations.

1e7e36b9a203f93b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أبدال للموارد البشرية عن صيدلي للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى الصيدلي مسؤولية دراسة وتحضير التركيبات الدوائية، وتحديد احتياجات الصيدلية من الأدوية والتجهيزات، بالإضافة إلى تنظيم إجراءات التخزين والصرف. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة مواصفات وتركيبات الأدوية والعقاقير والمواد الصيدلانية، وتحضيرها وصرفها وفقاً للوصفات الطبية. تحديد الآثار الجانبية المحتملة لاستخدام الأدوية وتأثيراتها على الإنسان. تحديد أنواع وكميات الأدوية والعلاجات المطلوبة للصيدلية، وإعداد وتدقيق طلبات الشراء. متابعة توفير واستلام وتخزين الأدوية بحسب سجلات الموجودات ووفق الأسس الصيدلانية. دراسة الوصفات الطبية وتجهيز الدواء قبل صرفه، وتقديم الإرشادات للمريض حول طريقة الاستعمال والآثار الجانبية المحتملة. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة التطورات في مجال الصيدلة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير الطبية المتعلقة بالصيدلة وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها، مع ضمان تطبيق مبادئ وقواعد السلامة العامة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال الصيدلة. القدرة على دراسة التركيبات الدوائية وتحضيرها. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات تخزين وصرف الأدوية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تنظيمية عالية لإدارة مخزون الصيدلية. القدرة على التواصل الفعال مع المرضى وتقديم الإرشادات اللازمة. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة العامة والإجراءات الصيدلانية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق الطبية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة أبدال للموارد البشرية. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل مهنية تدعم التطوير المستمر في مجال الصيدلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

1e92f36e07f8868e.description: About Tools & Solutions Tools & Solutions is a rapidly expanding B2B service provider operating across the GCC region. The company specializes in delivering comprehensive corporate business and digital solutions, serving a diverse client base that includes Saudi government entities, as well as prominent Saudi and international corporations. The Role: Senior .NET Developer Tools & Solutions is seeking a Senior .NET Developer for a full-time outsourcing opportunity in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role is responsible for the design, development, testing, implementation, and maintenance of high-quality software applications using .NET technologies within an enterprise environment. The Senior .NET Developer will contribute to application enhancement, troubleshoot technical issues, provide production support, and resolve software defects to ensure application stability and performance. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain scalable software applications using .NET technologies. Analyze business and technical requirements to translate them into effective and maintainable technical solutions. Write clean, efficient, secure, and well-documented code, adhering to software development best practices. Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve application issues, software defects, and production incidents. Provide production support for existing applications, ensuring system stability, availability, and performance. Perform testing, debugging, and code validation to identify and resolve defects before and after deployment. Investigate the root causes of technical issues and implement appropriate corrective and preventive solutions. Collaborate with developers, QA teams, technical teams, and business stakeholders to deliver reliable software solutions. Support application deployment, release management, maintenance, and continuous improvement activities. Maintain technical documentation and ensure adherence to coding standards and development best practices. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field. Minimum of 5 years of professional experience in .NET development. Strong proficiency in C# and .NET technologies, including .NET Core or modern .NET frameworks. Proven hands-on experience in software development, application maintenance, and enhancement. Practical experience in production support, troubleshooting, testing, debugging, and bug fixing. Strong understanding of software development principles, object-oriented programming, and the software development lifecycle. Ability to investigate technical issues, identify root causes, and implement effective solutions. Relevant technical certifications are considered an advantage. Required Skills Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills. Strong communication and collaboration skills. Application Process Candidates meeting the above requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1ebbf34817986726.description: About the Role Hilti Saudi Arabia is seeking an Account Manager for the Riyadh Region. This full-time role involves managing and expanding relationships with key construction and industrial clients during the execution phase of major projects. The Account Manager will serve as a strategic partner, integrating Hilti’s solutions into ongoing projects to enhance value, efficiency, and customer loyalty. Responsibilities Manage and cultivate relationships with key stakeholders on assigned projects, including contractors, engineers, and procurement teams. Ensure the effective implementation of Hilti products, software, and services during the mid-phase of construction projects. Identify opportunities for upselling and cross-selling within ongoing projects to maximize revenue. Provide technical consultation and product demonstrations to address specific project challenges. Coordinate with internal teams, such as engineering, logistics, marketing, and customer service, to ensure seamless project delivery. Monitor competitor activities, market trends, and customer feedback to inform strategic decisions. Maintain accurate records of project progress, sales activities, and forecasts using CRM tools. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of relevant experience. Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships and drive business development. Experience in the construction or industrial sector is preferred. Company Culture and Environment Hilti fosters a culture that balances autonomy with teamwork. The company provides extensive training, development, and opportunities for career mobility. Hilti was recognized as 3rd place in KSA 2026 “Great Place to Work,” offering growth opportunities both nationally and internationally. Hilti is a global leader in construction innovation with over 34,000 team members across 120 countries, guided by the purpose of "Making Construction Better." Commitment to Inclusion Hilti emphasizes inclusion in its work, leadership, and growth strategies. The company is committed to embracing diversity of thought and creating an inclusive environment where every voice is valued, and every team member feels empowered to contribute. This foundation strengthens teams, innovation, and overall impact.

1efa5e193e473f2f.description: Job description The Receptionist position in an automotive workshop is a key role in the transportation sector, playing a central part in managing daily operations. The Receptionist acts as a bridge between customers and technicians, ensuring exceptional service delivery and a positive customer experience. Through this role, you will have the opportunity to be part of a dynamic team striving to achieve the highest levels of customer satisfaction, which contributes to enhancing the company's market reputation. Responsibilities include handling customer inquiries, scheduling appointments, and managing service invoices. You will learn how to utilize modern workshop management systems, enhancing your technical skills and providing you with opportunities for career advancement. The supportive work environment encourages personal growth and continuous learning, allowing you to acquire new skills and expand your knowledge in the automotive and maintenance services field. This position is an excellent starting point for those interested in the automotive industry, as it allows you to build a strong professional network and develop your skills in customer service. Over time, you may advance to higher positions such as Workshop Supervisor or Service Manager, giving you the chance to influence operations and improve overall workshop performance. Discover how you can contribute to our team's success today! Responsibilities: Welcoming customers upon their arrival at the workshop and providing accurate information about available services, ensuring a positive experience for customers. Scheduling maintenance and repair appointments, coordinating with technicians to ensure resources are available at the specified time. Managing service invoices and presenting them to customers, contributing to improving cash flow and ensuring transparency. Communicating with customers to follow up on the status of their vehicles, providing regular updates to enhance customer trust. Providing administrative support to technicians by organizing files and records, facilitating quick access to necessary information. Monitoring the inventory of spare parts and materials, ensuring their availability in a timely manner to meet workshop needs. Assisting in marketing the workshop's services through interaction with customers via social media, increasing brand awareness. Analyzing customer feedback and providing recommendations to improve service quality, enhancing the customer experience. Participating in training sessions and workshops to enhance personal and technical skills, contributing to improving personal and professional performance. Skills Effective communication skills with customers and colleagues, along with proficiency in English and computer literacy. Ability to manage time efficiently for coordinating appointments and daily tasks. Strong knowledge of modern workshop management systems and technologies in the automotive field. High organizational skills to assist in managing records and documentation effectively. Ability to work under pressure and handle multiple tasks simultaneously. Analytical skills to evaluate customer feedback and propose suitable improvements. Ability to work within a team and foster collaboration to achieve shared goals.

1e59463dc6b79e4f.description: Job Purpose HanmiGlobal is seeking a highly qualified Program Director to join our program management and PMCM team in Saudi Arabia. In this role, you will provide executive stewardship and overarching leadership for a mega multi-work package land and infrastructure development program in Riyadh, delivered on behalf of a major government entity. You will be providing program-level leadership, governance, strategic integration, and executive oversight across all phases of the program, serving as the principal representative to the Client and ensuring all program participants are seamlessly aligned across scope, schedule, cost, quality, safety, risk, sustainability, and stakeholder expectations, while supporting the successful delivery of the overall development program. Reports To Client Executive Management Key Responsibilities Provide executive leadership and strategic direction for the PMCM organization, establishing governance frameworks, reporting structures, decision-making processes, and performance management systems aligned with Client’s objectives. Lead, mentor, and manage the multidisciplinary PMCM leadership team while fostering a culture of collaboration, accountability, innovation, and continuous improvement. Direct and oversee all program activities, including planning, design management, procurement support, construction management, testing and commissioning, handover, and project close-out. Ensure effective integration of all technical, commercial, project controls, quality, HSE, and risk management functions, while monitoring Lead Developer performance against approved scope, schedule, budget, quality, and contractual obligations. Provide executive oversight of commercial management, project controls, cost forecasting, contract administration, claims, variations, and dispute resolution. Lead program-wide risk management, quality assurance, and health, safety, and environmental (HSE) initiatives to ensure compliance with contractual, regulatory, and corporate requirements. Review executive dashboards, KPIs, performance reports, and strategic recommendations to support informed decision-making and proactive management of program performance. Serve as the primary executive interface with the Client and maintain strong relationships with Lead Developers, consultants, contractors, utility providers, government agencies, and key stakeholders. Chair executive meetings, governance reviews, stakeholder workshops, and high-level coordination sessions, facilitating timely resolution of critical issues and strategic decisions. Qualifications & Experience Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related discipline. Chartered Professional membership or equivalent professional accreditation. Minimum twenty (20) years of professional experience, including at least twelve (12) years in senior leadership roles such as Program Director, Projects Director, Project Director, or equivalent. Demonstrated experience leading major land development, infrastructure, transportation, utilities, urban development, or mega-project programs within PMCM, PMC, EPCM, or client-side organizations, preferably in Saudi Arabia or the GCC. Interface With Internal Interfaces HanmiGlobal Executive Management Corporate Technical Support Functions Corporate Commercial Department Corporate HR Department Corporate Finance Department PMCM Project Team Other HanmiGlobal Business Units (as required) External Interfaces Client Lead Developers Design Consultants Contractors Utility Providers Government Authorities Regulatory Agencies Specialist Consultants Third-Party Reviewers and Approving Authorities Community Stakeholders Core Competencies Strategic Program Leadership PMCM Governance & Executive Management Mega Infrastructure & Land Development Programs Design & Construction Management Oversight Commercial & Contract Management Project Controls & Performance Management Cost, Risk & Quality Management HSE Leadership & Regulatory Compliance Digital Delivery (PMIS, EDMS & BIM) Stakeholder & Government Authority Management Executive Reporting & Organizational Leadership Strategic Decision-Making, Communication, Negotiation, and Problem Solving

1e6d34d0257847ee.description: About Riyadh Air Riyadh Air is a new national airline based in Saudi Arabia, aiming to connect the Kingdom to over 100 destinations by 2030. The airline is committed to delivering exceptional service and setting new standards in the aviation industry. Role Summary Riyadh Air is seeking a Direct Entry Captain B to join its flight operations team. This is a contract position based in Saudi Arabia, offering a monthly salary. The role involves operating flights in accordance with company standards and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Commanding aircraft safely and efficiently on scheduled and non-scheduled flights. Ensuring compliance with all aviation regulations, company policies, and operational procedures. Maintaining a high level of situational awareness and decision-making during all phases of flight. Leading the flight crew and fostering a professional and collaborative working environment. Conducting pre-flight preparations, in-flight operations, and post-flight duties as required. Qualifications and Requirements Possession of an Airline Transport Pilot License (ATPL). Current and valid medical certificate. Demonstrated experience as a Captain on relevant aircraft types. Ability to work effectively in a dynamic and fast-paced operational environment. Strong communication and leadership skills. Work Type and Compensation This is a contract position with Riyadh Air. The compensation for this role includes a monthly salary. 1e74e1c45cbfa929.description: About ABB At ABB, we are committed to helping industries operate more efficiently and sustainably. This is achieved through the contributions of every individual within our organization. We empower our employees to lead, support their professional growth, and foster pride in our collective impact. The Role of Country Holding Officer The Country Holding Officer is responsible for ensuring that ABB operates according to required standards and maintains compliance with all fiduciary requirements across the country. This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and reports to the Global CHO Lead, Electrification. The role coordinates local functions and business organizations to ensure consistency, expertise, and regulatory focus, while representing ABB at the local governance level and leading the finance front office. Key Objectives Beyond maintaining regulatory compliance, this role aims to establish an agile business platform that enables divisions to adapt with flexibility. Key priorities include driving process simplification, reducing complexity, and supporting the business to secure a highly motivated and skilled workforce for sustainable growth. Responsibilities Ensuring effective collaboration between businesses, consistent with the "ABB-Way." Actively seeking opportunities to simplify and streamline processes. Establishing and maintaining local governance in line with regulations while eliminating internal complexity. Fulfilling and coordinating fiduciary duties for ABB's local legal entities, supporting all respective functions, Business Areas, and Divisions. Acting as the authorized signatory for compliance with local regulations, statutory, tax, treasury, and HSE requirements. Representing ABB locally or organizing representation by another local leader/expert, focusing on external representation (*, in associations, government relations), and actively managing partnerships and external (non-customer) stakeholders when significant across several local businesses. Responsible for compliance with all applicable local fiduciary finance requirements, overseeing compliance with US GAAP, local reporting, internal controls, legal, and tax requirements, with support from respective functions. This includes oversight and alignment of Real Estate across the country. Consulted on, facilitating, and supporting global business for the Country within scope for M&A activities, reorganizations, restructuring, non-core activities, and carve-outs, as requested. Leading or actively supporting the local aspects of global projects, as needed. Maintaining relations with external auditors and communicating their local findings and recommendations to the appropriate organization for remediation (*, Business, Finance Services, or Corporate). Championing process simplification and elimination of non-value-added activities across all fiduciary and governance functions. Acting as strong local leadership for corporate/globally owned functions such as Country Communications, Government Relations, HR, Legal, Tax, and Treasury. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of relevant experience. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia.

1e43be416326c70c.description: About the Role Inspira Enterprise is seeking an IBM Security Identity Manager (ISIM) Consultant to join their team in Riyadh. This full-time role involves designing, implementing, and supporting IBM Identity and Access Management (IAM) solutions, specifically utilizing ISIM and IBM Identity Governance and Intelligence (IGI). The consultant will be responsible for managing the complete identity lifecycle within enterprise environments. Key Responsibilities Configure and maintain Single Sign-On (SSO), Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA), and federation solutions. Implement identity governance processes, including access certifications and Segregation of Duties (SoD). Integrate IAM platforms with various enterprise applications, directories, databases, HR systems, and cloud environments. Develop and customize workflows, provisioning policies, connectors, and adapters to automate identity management processes. Manage the end-to-end identity lifecycle, encompassing user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role management. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 3-5 years of experience with IBM IAM solutions. Demonstrated end-to-end implementation experience with IBM Security Identity Manager (ISIM) and IBM Identity Governance and Intelligence (IGI). Experience in integrating enterprise applications and directories with IAM platforms. Hands-on experience with the implementation of Single Sign-On (SSO), federation, and Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA). Experience in designing workflows and governance policies related to identity management. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, requiring dedicated engagement in the design, implementation, and support of critical IBM IAM solutions. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

1e8b5c443fcacdab.description: About Keenfinity Group Keenfinity Group is a global provider of security and communication solutions, with over 4,000 employees across more than 50 countries. The company focuses on securing, connecting, and amplifying important moments through technology. Keenfinity fosters a work environment based on trust, appreciation, and accountability, promoting a customer-focused approach and strong team spirit. The Role of Business Development Manager Keenfinity Group is seeking a Business Development Manager to join its Inspiring Audio Business. This full-time role is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and focuses on driving business growth by identifying new opportunities, developing strategic partnerships, expanding customer relationships, and achieving revenue targets. The position requires frequent travel, strong commercial acumen, and the ability to work across diverse markets and cultures. Key Responsibilities Develop and execute a regional business development strategy for the assigned territory. Identify new market opportunities, customer segments, and growth areas. Conduct market intelligence on competitors, pricing, industry trends, and customer needs. Support market entry and expansion initiatives in new territories. Achieve annual sales and revenue targets across assigned countries. Build and maintain a strong sales pipeline, leading the complete sales cycle from prospecting to contract signing. Prepare commercial proposals, quotations, and business cases, and negotiate contracts and commercial agreements. Develop long-term relationships with key customers, distributors, and strategic partners, managing relationships with senior decision-makers. Ensure high customer satisfaction and retention, and establish channel partners, distributors, and resellers where applicable. Manage business activities within Saudi Arabia, traveling regularly to meet customers, partners, and government stakeholders. Identify and develop strategic alliances with industry players, participating in tenders, RFPs, and large-scale projects. Build relationships with government agencies, industry associations, and key influencers, representing the company at trade shows and conferences. Collaborate with sales, marketing, technical, finance, and operations teams, coordinating proposal preparation and customer solutions. Provide market feedback to support product and service development. Prepare monthly sales forecasts and pipeline reports, monitoring KPIs and business performance. Maintain CRM records and customer data, and present business reviews and market insights to management. Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in business development or a related field. Demonstrated ability to achieve sales and revenue targets. Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills. Experience working across diverse markets and cultures. Ability to travel frequently as required by the role. What Keenfinity Offers Keenfinity offers a challenging role with development opportunities within an international environment. The position includes a competitive salary and benefits package, commensurate with experience, along with ongoing professional and personal development opportunities. Commitment to Diversity and Flexibility Keenfinity is committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace and encourages applications from all suitably qualified candidates. The company offers flexible working arrangements, including part-time options, hybrid/mobile working, and job sharing, subject to business requirements. Candidates are welcome to discuss these options further.

1ea36b413ce454c9.description: About AECOM AECOM is a global infrastructure consulting firm focused on delivering a better world through various projects, including improving commutes, providing clean water access, and transforming skylines. The company partners with clients to address complex challenges and build legacies for future generations. With a global team of over 50,000 professionals, AECOM delivers projects that create a positive and tangible impact worldwide. Job Summary AECOM is seeking a Mechanical Engineer - Design to join its engineering team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves designing, developing, and optimizing mechanical components and systems. The successful candidate will collaborate with cross-functional teams to translate concepts into functional designs, ensuring compliance with industry standards and manufacturing feasibility. A minimum of 10 years of experience is required for this position. Key Responsibilities Develop detailed mechanical designs and technical drawings using CAD software, ensuring accuracy and adherence to engineering specifications. Conduct design analysis and simulations to evaluate performance, stress, and durability of mechanical components. Analyze design requirements and translate them into comprehensive design solutions that meet functional and operational objectives. Collaborate with manufacturing, quality, and product teams to ensure designs are feasible, cost-effective, and aligned with production capabilities. Perform material selection and analysis to optimize component performance and manufacturing efficiency. Document design modifications and maintain organized design files and project records. Review and validate designs against industry standards, codes, and regulatory requirements. Participate in design reviews and provide technical recommendations for continuous improvement. Support prototyping and testing phases by providing design guidance and troubleshooting technical issues. Maintain organized project documentation and ensure all design files are properly archived and version-controlled. Candidate Profile The ideal candidate will be detail-oriented and analytical, possessing a strong background in mechanical design. This role requires a professional with over 10 years of experience in mechanical engineering design, capable of working collaboratively within cross-functional teams. Work Environment and Culture AECOM fosters a global team environment that supports professional growth and career ambitions. Employees work on projects that impact local communities and global infrastructure. The company provides resources, including cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, to facilitate impactful work. AECOM offers training and development programs designed to enhance technical expertise and leadership skills. The workplace is built on respect, collaboration, and community. Application Process As part of AECOM's commitment to a secure recruitment process, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment. All application information will be kept confidential according to Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) guidelines.

1e8057f0eaee03f8.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة الصقور للحراسات الأمنية عن مراقب كاميرات أمنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يركز هذا الدور على الإشراف على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة الأمنية وتشغيل أنظمة المراقبة، بالإضافة إلى التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ الأمنية والاستجابة لها على مدار الساعة. تتطلب الوظيفة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، وهي بدوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية الإشراف على عمليات كاميرات المراقبة الأمنية وضمان فعاليتها. التعامل مع حالات الإنذار وطوارئ الحرائق والتحقيق فيها، مع ضمان الاستجابة الفورية على مدار الساعة. تشغيل أنظمة الإنذار وكاميرات المراقبة ومراقبتها وصيانتها بشكل دوري. تنزيل وإدارة التسجيلات الأمنية لاستخدامها في التحقيقات المستقبلية، مع الالتزام بقواعد ولوائح خصوصية البيانات. التحقيق في الحالات الطارئة وأي انتهاكات للسياسات والإجراءات الأمنية المعتمدة. اتباع السياسات والإجراءات الأمنية التي تتوافق مع القوانين واللوائح المعمول بها. إبلاغ الإدارة بالمشكلات الأمنية عند حدوثها ورفع التقارير المتعلقة بالأسباب والنتائج. تقديم التوصيات اللازمة للإدارة بشأن مسار العمل والإجراءات التصحيحية. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال مراقبة الكاميرات الأمنية أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على العمل بفعالية في بيئة تتطلب الاستجابة السريعة لحالات الطوارئ. معرفة بأنظمة المراقبة والإنذار وكيفية تشغيلها وصيانتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في الملاحظة والانتباه للتفاصيل. القدرة على اتخاذ قرارات سريعة وفعالة تحت الضغط. مهارات تواصل جيدة لتقديم التقارير والتوصيات. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات الأمنية وقواعد خصوصية البيانات. بيئة العمل يعمل مراقب الكاميرات الأمنية في مدينة الرياض، ضمن بيئة عمل ديناميكية تتطلب اليقظة والاستعداد للتعامل مع مختلف المواقف الأمنية على مدار الساعة. الوظيفة بدوام كامل. تقديم الطلبات إذا كنت تمتلك المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة، ندعوك للتقدم لهذه الوظيفة للانضمام إلى فريق شركة الصقور للحراسات الأمنية.

1e96bd32f1ac3c37.description: About the Role AlRomaih Industrial Commercial Group is seeking a Showroom Sales Representative to join their team in Makkah. This full-time role focuses on ensuring excellent customer reception and service, managing inventory, and achieving sales targets within the showroom environment. The representative will be responsible for supporting customers from their initial entry to post-sales follow-up. Key Responsibilities Provide excellent customer reception and maintain a high level of service within the showrooms. Address customer needs, facilitate goods delivery, and offer pre- and post-sales support. Guide customers through product introductions, secure orders, calculate quantities, and assist with product and color coordination. Coordinate with showroom staff, including assistants, workers, and drivers, to ensure accurate invoicing and timely goods delivery. Maintain the organization and cleanliness of the showroom and ensure the availability of marketing materials such as brochures and catalogues. Achieve sales targets in line with the established sales plan and implement Key Performance Indicators (KPIs). Process online customer requests and update the E-commerce platform, considering stock levels and required items. Manage stock levels by ordering from warehouses based on minimum and maximum levels, prioritizing fast-moving items. Adhere to the first-in, first-out (FIFO) policy to prevent dead stock and report any missing products to the direct manager. Ensure goods are arranged in warehouses according to policy to maintain accurate stock and prevent discrepancies during inventory checks. Submit financial reports to the region accountant as required and deposit daily sales cash into the company’s account. Provide regular reports to the direct manager on competitors' activities and promotions. Handle customer complaints professionally and report them to the direct manager. Cooperate with other branches to resell slow-moving items and implement company policies and instructions. Submit periodic reports on achievements, problems, and failures to the direct manager. Offer suggestions for developing sales processes and value. Perform all duties using safe and environmentally sound methods, and undertake any other tasks assigned by the direct supervisor. Work Environment The Showroom Sales Representative will operate within a dynamic retail environment, collaborating with various showroom personnel and engaging directly with customers. The role requires adherence to company policies and procedures, with a focus on maintaining an organized and efficient sales operation. Application Process Candidates interested in this full-time Showroom Sales Representative position are encouraged to apply.

1ed29a67466a9477.description: About Havelock One Interiors Havelock One Interiors has operated as a leading turnkey fit-out service provider in the Middle East since 1998. The company specializes in interior contracting and the manufacturing of bespoke joinery, metalworks, and sophisticated shop fittings. Due to expansion in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), Havelock One Interiors is seeking experienced leaders to contribute to business growth. The Role: Senior Projects Manager Havelock One Interiors is seeking a Senior Projects Manager to join the team in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves the overall planning, coordination, and control of fast-track fit-out projects from inception to completion. The primary objective is to deliver financially viable projects on time, within budget, and to the required quality standards, meeting client requirements across various sectors including Hospitality, Hotels, High End Residential, Palaces, F&B, Retail, Entertainment, Health, and Education. Key Responsibilities Work towards the creation and execution of business development strategies aligned with company goals. Research and build relationships with new clients. Attend industry functions, such as association events and conferences, providing feedback on market and creative trends. Supervise the end-to-end tendering process. Identify stakeholders and plan communications. Develop project management plans and schedules, ensuring activities are clearly defined for all stakeholders. Plan procurement in line with project schedules. Identify risks and plan risk management and responses. Specify project objectives and plans, including scope delineation, budgeting, scheduling, setting performance requirements, and selecting subcontractors. Interface with the project team to share best practices and ensure effective resource utilization (labor, materials, and equipment). Implement various operations through proper coordination and control of planning, design, estimating, contracting, and construction. Maintain accurate records as construction progresses throughout projects. Oversee construction sites and manage vendors and trades. Analyze and share regular updates on site operations with relevant stakeholders. Maintain good communication with clients at all times. Direct and manage project execution, ensuring all works are properly monitored, coordinated, and controlled. Acquire, develop, and manage the project team. Conduct and administer procurement in line with project schedules. Distribute project information to relevant stakeholders. Perform quality assurance and control throughout the project lifecycle. Manage all local municipality and government approvals required for project operation and handover in line with the project schedule. Verify and control any changes in scope and costs. Control project invoicing and final accounting. Monitor and control risks. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project management. Proven experience in managing fast-track fit-out projects. Demonstrated ability to manage projects from inception to completion. Work Environment and Location This full-time position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires flexibility and adaptability, as projects are undertaken across the country. The company offers an established work environment and a corporate culture that values loyalty and respect. Application Process Havelock One Interiors is conducting interviews with well-qualified candidates interested in advancing their careers within this key growth market.

1ed47560d8c42383.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة إم إيه بي كونسولت للاستشارات الهندسية عن مهندس معماري للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى 1 سنة، حيث سيساهم في تصميم المباني الجديدة وتعديل القائمة، بالإضافة إلى تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المباني الجديدة أو الملحقات أو التعديلات على المباني القائمة. تقديم المشورة بشأن ترميم الممتلكات القديمة والمحافظة عليها. المساعدة في اختيار الموقع ومباشرة أعمال الإنشاءات. وضع التصاميم لمشاريع الإنشاءات وإدارة فريق التصميم في اختيار المواد وتطوير المواصفات. إعداد نماذج بالحجم الطبيعي والرسومات والنماذج الرقمية. المساعدة في اختيار المقاولين واختيار المواد. تقديم الدعم لمشروعات الإنشاء، ومباشرة تنفيذ التصميم من قِبل المقاول. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة بالأعمال والمشروعات الهندسية ونسب تقدمها وعرضها وتوضيحها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الهندسة المعمارية. القدرة على تصميم المباني وتعديلها. معرفة بأساسيات ترميم الممتلكات والمحافظة عليها. بيئة العمل يعمل المهندس المعماري ضمن فريق شركة إم إيه بي كونسولت للاستشارات الهندسية في مدينة الرياض، في بيئة عمل داعمة تركز على تنفيذ المشاريع الهندسية بكفاءة واحترافية. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل، وتتطلب التزاماً كاملاً بالمهام والمسؤوليات المحددة لضمان سير العمل بفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة خلال عملية التوظيف.

1ede3eba7c601ec0.description: About the Role Hilton Riyadh Hotel & Residences is seeking a Chef De Partie to join their team in Jeddah, Makkah. This full-time role involves preparing and cooking a la carte menu items, ensuring consistency in taste, portion, presentation, and quality. The Chef De Partie will also maintain mise en place before each service and prepare food according to guest dietary requirements and special requests. This position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Prepare and cook all à la carte menu items according to standard recipes, ensuring consistency in taste, portion, presentation, and quality. Maintain mise en place before each service and prepare food according to guest dietary requirements and special requests. Ensure food is served at the correct temperature and monitor food quality throughout preparation and service. Coordinate with the IRD service team for timely delivery and prioritize orders based on service timing. Handle high-volume periods efficiently, minimize food waiting time, and ensure all orders leave the kitchen accurately and attractively presented. Complete kitchen checklists, maintain production records, report daily issues, and attend kitchen meetings. 1e046a8ae45df7ac.description: About the Role D360 Bank is seeking an Associate Manager Anti Bribery & Corruption to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for supporting the organization's efforts to develop, implement, and monitor a robust Anti-Bribery & Corruption (ABC) program. The Associate Manager will assist in the ABC risk assessment process, manage the whistle-blowing mechanism, and ensure accurate financial crimes reporting, working closely with cross-functional teams to ensure compliance with relevant regulations. Key Responsibilities The Associate Manager Anti Bribery & Corruption will play a key role in identifying, mitigating, and managing risks related to bribery, corruption, and financial crimes, fostering a culture of integrity across the organization. Specific responsibilities include: Assisting in ABC-related investigations, including evidence collection, documentary review, system log and transaction analysis, and background checks under supervision. Receiving, logging, and triaging allegations of bribery, corruption, internal fraud, and conflicts of interest, and escalating matters as defined. Supporting investigation interviews through preparation of question sets, note-taking, and drafting interview records. Preserving the integrity of evidence, including chain of custody, access restrictions, and confidentiality of case information. Drafting investigation reports outlining background, methodology, findings, root cause, and recommended corrective actions. Tracking agreed remediation and disciplinary actions arising from investigations through to closure. Whistleblowing and Escalation Handling internal fraud cases received through whistleblowing channels, including initial assessment, classification, and escalation recommendations. Maintaining strict confidentiality and reporter anonymity throughout the case lifecycle, adhering to non-retaliation requirements. Ensuring whistleblowing cases are documented, tracked, and closed in accordance with policy and regulatory requirements. Escalating internal fraud cases of defined significance, materiality, or sensitivity promptly with a preliminary case summary. Preparing draft escalation memoranda, committee papers, and regulatory notification templates for significant internal fraud cases. Identifying and documenting emerging internal fraud typologies, recurring red flags, and material control weaknesses for management reporting. Training and Awareness Assisting in preparing and delivering training and awareness materials on ABC, internal fraud, and whistleblowing for employees, management, and third parties. Supporting induction and periodic refresher training sessions, and coordinating role-specific training for higher-risk functions. Coordinating with Human Resources, Learning & Development, and Corporate Communications on training campaigns and awareness materials. Supporting the development of ABC and internal fraud awareness initiatives to promote a strong fraud risk culture. Preparing awareness materials on whistleblowing channels, covering reporting methods, confidentiality, and protection from retaliation. Monitoring training completion rates, following up on non-completion, and maintaining complete and auditable training records. Assessing the effectiveness of training and awareness activities and updating materials to reflect developments and findings. Financial Crime Alignment Participating in coordination forums and working groups between internal fraud, AML, compliance, information security, cyber crime, and counter-fraud functions. Coordinating with relevant internal functions on cases presenting cross-functional exposure, including cyber-enabled internal fraud and potential money laundering indicators. Supporting information sharing between control functions on cases, red flags, and typologies within applicable confidentiality and data protection limits. Identifying and documenting linkages and recurring patterns across internal fraud, cyber, and other financial crime cases for reporting. Enforcing and complying with all necessary controls and related information security policies, procedures, and practices within departmental activities. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience. The role requires a strong understanding of anti-bribery, anti-corruption, and financial crimes regulations, along with the ability to work effectively in a cross-functional environment. The ideal candidate will demonstrate a commitment to integrity and meticulous attention to detail.

1ef18f7666d684f6.description: Important — please read before applying • You must currently be based in the KSA on a valid residence or employment visa. Candidates based outside the KSA will not be considered. • Monthly salary for this role is SAR 8,000–12,000. If your expectations are significantly above this range, please consider whether this role is right for you before applying. • All free-text application questions require a minimum of 2–3 sentences. Single-word or numeric answers will result in automatic disqualification. About Purple Rock IT Solutions Purple Rock IT Solutions is an IT infrastructure, networking, and systems integration company delivering enterprise IT solutions, managed services, and large-scale event technology deployments across the UAE and Saudi Arabia. Our projects range from corporate offices and managed IT environments to international events, exhibitions, sporting venues, and temporary network deployments. We are looking for a hands-on Network Engineer who is equally comfortable on a project site at 11pm during an event build-up as they are configuring a FortiGate firewall for an MSP client the next morning. This is a field-heavy, deployment-focused role and is not suitable for candidates seeking purely desk-based, NOC-only, or remote positions. You will work across two environments: • MSP clients — ongoing support, configuration, monitoring, and troubleshooting for a portfolio of corporate clients across KSA. • Event & project deployments — design, deploy, operate, and decommission temporary network infrastructure for exhibitions, conferences, sporting events, and activations, often under tight timelines and high-pressure conditions. Mandatory technical requirements Candidates without the following will not be progressed: • Hands-on experience configuring and deploying Fortinet FortiGate firewalls (VPN, firewall policies, NAT, SD-WAN). Please specify which models you have worked with. • Hands-on experience deploying and managing Ubiquiti UniFi wireless networks, including UniFi controllers, APs, and switching. Please specify your largest deployment. • Confirmed, documentable event or temporary network deployment experience — see application form requirement below. • Currently based in the KSA on a valid visa with the right to work. Network infrastructure • Configure, deploy, and maintain LAN, WAN, and wireless network infrastructure. • Install, configure, and troubleshoot switches, routers, firewalls, access points, and related network services. • Manage routing, switching, firewall, VPN, and wireless environments across MSP client sites. • Perform firmware upgrades, security updates, preventive maintenance, and optimisation activities. Event network support • Deploy and manage enterprise wireless and wired networks for large-scale events (500–20,000+ users), including exhibitions, sporting events, conferences, and activations. • Configure high-density UniFi or equivalent wireless deployments with proper VLAN segmentation and guest isolation. • Set up bonded cellular and SD-WAN uplinks using Peplink or equivalent for event connectivity and failover. • Monitor bandwidth utilisation and network performance during live events. • Provide on-site support during build-up, live operations, and de-rig — including evenings, weekends, and public holidays. • Troubleshoot network issues calmly and effectively under time-critical, high-visibility conditions. Troubleshooting & MSP support • Diagnose and resolve network connectivity, performance, and security issues for MSP clients. • Perform root cause analysis for recurring incidents and implement permanent corrective actions. • Support MSP clients through remote and on-site troubleshooting. • Participate in escalation support for critical incidents and service outages. Project delivery • Support network implementation, migration, expansion, and infrastructure upgrade projects. • Participate in site surveys, wireless heatmap surveys (Ekahau or equivalent), and solution deployment. • Work closely with project managers, technical teams, and vendors. Documentation • Create and maintain network diagrams using Microsoft Visio. • Document configurations, IP schemes, topology diagrams, and SOPs. • Prepare technical reports and change records. Requirements • 2–4 years of experience in network deployment and support. • Diploma or Bachelor’s Degree in IT, Networking, Computer Science, or related field. • Strong understanding of TCP/IP, subnetting, routing, switching, VLANs, STP, DHCP, DNS, NAT, and VPN. • Proven ability to work independently under pressure with minimal supervision. • Genuine willingness to work evenings, weekends, and public holidays for event and project work. • Valid KSA residence or employment visa — no relocation or visa sponsorship for overseas candidates. Preferred qualifications & experience • Fortinet NSE / FCP certification. • Experience with Cisco/Meraki, Aruba, Peplink, Sophos, or Ruijie solutions. • Wireless heatmap survey experience using Ekahau or NetSpot. • Experience in MSP environments managing multiple clients simultaneously. • Event network deployment experience at scale (500+ users). • CCNA/CCNP, Ubiquiti UEWA, or Peplink certifications are an advantage. • Exposure to high-profile events and infrastructure projects across the KSA. • Training and certification sponsorship (Fortinet NSE, Ubiquiti, Peplink, Ekahau). • Career growth within a fast-growing systems integration and MSP company. • A hands-on technical environment — no bureaucracy, direct project ownership.
